summary: With the adoption of the Vision Zero Road Safety Plan, residents, local schools and community groups are requesting the adoption of 30km/hour speed limits on local residential streets in Ward 13 to improve the safety of vulnerable road users, including children, seniors, pedestrians and cyclists. I am requesting that the following local residential streets in Ward 13 be reduced to 30km/hour: Larkin Avenue Bradley Avenue Durie Street – Bloor Street West to Colbeck Street Halford Avenue – Old Mill Drive to Humberview Road Priscilla Avenue – Hanley Street to Dundas Street West Gilmour Avenue – Annette Street to Dundas Street West Rexford Road.
decided: Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit to 30km/hour on the following streets: Larkin Avenue Bradley Avenue Durie Street – Bloor Street West to Colbeck Street Halford Avenue – Old Mill Drive to Humberview Road Priscilla Avenue – Hanley Street to Dundas Street West Gilmour Avenue – Annette Street to Dundas Street West Rexford Road.
